# Unity.Rea.Incognito — User Stories
> ✅ done (shipped & tested) · 🟡 partial · ⬜ planned. Every ✅ cites the test.

## Priority backlog
_Nothing recorded yet._


## Epic A — Reverse-engineer and rebuild Incognito (2013 GameMaker prototype) in Unity
- **U.INC-US-A1 ✅** As a player, I walk left/right with a gentle triangle-wave vertical bob (ramping between a min/max offset, not a literal sine) that quickens while sprinting, so movement feels alive instead of robotic. *(verified by `PlayerLocomotionStateTests` (Core.Tests: `Bob_oscillates_between_amplitude_bounds_while_walking`, `Sprint_ramps_up_to_double_speed_instead_of_snapping`).)*
- **U.INC-US-A2 ✅** As a player, the camera holds my character pinned near the screen edge opposite my facing direction (leading room ahead of me) while panning vertically with the mouse, so the view stays close and intimate instead of centering me. *(verified by `CloseFramingCameraStateTests` (Core.Tests: `Snap_pins_the_player_near_the_trailing_edge`, `Vertical_pan_follows_mouse_height_and_is_bounded`).)*
- **U.INC-US-A3 ✅** As a player, my cursor doubles as my character's visible eye: the pupil tracks the mouse with a parallax offset and blinks on a randomized idle timer, and the on-screen cursor sprite itself changes to reflect look/talk/pointer/aim modes. *(verified by `EyeballStateTests` (Core.Tests: `Pupil_is_damped_parallax_not_one_to_one`, `Blink_rolls_irandom_range_0_to_160_each_idle_step`, `Each_mode_shows_its_own_sprite`).)*
- **U.INC-US-A4 ✅** As a player, scrolling the mouse wheel cycles the cursor between look mode (hover an NPC to read a floating description) and talk mode (click an NPC to walk over and start a conversation). *(verified by `CursorModeCyclingTests` (EditMode: `Wheel_either_way_cycles`, `Npc_click_action_follows_the_cursor_mode`).)*
- **U.INC-US-A5 ✅** As a player, clicking an NPC in pointer mode opens a hacking/console overlay on that NPC (a Shadowrun-style 'matrix' panel), separate from the look/talk interactions. *(verified by `HackingOverlayTests` (EditMode: `Pointer_click_hacks_the_npc_and_raises_the_active_program_icon`).)*
- **U.INC-US-A6 ✅** As a player, NPCs patrol between waypoints with the same idle bob animation and raise a visible suspicion meter driven by my proximity, whether we're facing each other, and whether I'm looking down (console/menu open), so stealth has Shadowrun-flavored social detection. *(verified by `NpcPatrolStateTests` and `SuspicionMeterTests` (Core.Tests: `Loops_the_route_turning_at_each_waypoint`, `Bobs_like_the_player_while_walking`, `Close_eye_contact_raises_suspicion_fastest`, `Looking_down_while_facing_bleeds_suspicion_off`).)*
- **U.INC-US-A7 ✅** As a player, I can draw/holster a weapon through an equip animation, aim with the arm pivoting toward the mouse, and fire a bullet that travels and can hit an NPC. *(verified by `PlayerWeaponStateTests`, `BulletStateTests` (Core.Tests) and `BulletTests` (EditMode).)*
- **U.INC-US-A8 ✅** As a player, I can open a typed command console (help/list/reboot/overwrite/clear) that queries nearby objects by type, echoing the original terminal/hacking mini-game. *(verified by `CommandInterpreterTests` (Core.Tests) and `TerminalRuntimeTests` (EditMode).)*
- **U.INC-US-A9 ✅** As a player, the street/shop/title rooms are rebuilt as Unity scenes with the original parallax clouds, rain, and lamplight props, playing the original footstep/whoosh/door/type sound effects and music tracks. *(verified by `RoomTraversalPlayTests` (PlayMode: `Every_room_is_reachable_from_the_title_and_every_exit_lands_where_the_original_put_the_player`) and `RoomSceneBuilderTests` (EditMode).)*
- **U.INC-US-A10 ✅** As a player, a pistol icon rises from the bottom-right of the screen (spr_icon_pistol, swapping to spr_icon_pistol_selected while the gun is out) and clicking it draws or holsters the gun exactly like Z, with the original sfx_flick click sound on icon and console clicks, so the HUD gun toggle of the original works. *(verified by `HudPistolIconPlayTests` (PlayMode: `The_pistol_icon_rises_and_a_click_draws_and_holsters_the_gun`, `A_console_click_selects_it_and_flicks`).)*
- **U.INC-US-A11 ✅** As a player, every original sound the live game used is present: sfx_flick (HUD clicks) and the whispers ambient loop (imported and kept as room data, unwired exactly as in the original), so no audio the original played is missing. *(verified by `OriginalAudioParityTests` (Core.Tests: `Every_sound_a_live_original_object_plays_is_catalogued_wired_and_on_disk`, `Whispers_is_imported_and_catalogued_but_unwired_as_in_the_original`).)*
- **U.INC-US-A12 ✅** As a player, all text is drawn in the original's fonts (fnt_basic 12pt Arial, fnt_large, fnt_system) with the original's outlined-text look, as real UI Toolkit/TextMesh text rather than IMGUI, so the prose and labels read as they did. *(verified by `OriginalFontParityTests`, `GmTextTests` (Core.Tests) and `OriginalTextPlayTests` (PlayMode: `Room_npc_console_and_floating_text_use_the_original_fonts_and_outlines`).)*
- **U.INC-US-A13 ✅** As a player, the game runs at the original's 1920x1080 reference with the original's screen-ratio setup (obj_startup), letterboxed on other aspects, starting fullscreen from the title as the original did. *(verified by `ScreenRatioTests` (Core.Tests) and `GameDisplayTests` (EditMode).)*
- **U.INC-US-A14 ✅** As a player, every sprite and background a live original object or room uses is in the rebuild (spr_exit_side, spr_barrier, spr_command_prompt and its selected variant, spr_console, spr_icon_pistol and selected, spr_linewall and the rest of the inventory in RECONSTRUCTION.md section 10), proven by a test that diffs the original's live asset list against the rebuild's. *(verified by `OriginalArtParityTests` (Core.Tests: `Every_image_a_live_original_object_or_room_uses_is_catalogued_at_its_origin_and_on_disk`).)*
- **U.INC-US-A15 ⬜** As the owner, the finished game is verified end to end against the reconstruction by a scripted run that plays title to every room and every mechanic and captures screenshots, so the repo can be called a complete proof of concept of the original.
